description: This file is a shell script (wwan.sh) that manages WWAN (Wireless Wide Area Network) device initialization, configuration, and setup. It includes functions for setting up various WWAN protocols and handles USB device detection and configuration for cellular modems.

methods.name: proto_mbim_setup
methods.description: Logs that the MBIM protocol setup is missing.

methods.name: proto_qmi_setup
methods.description: Logs that the QMI protocol setup is missing.

methods.name: proto_ncm_setup
methods.description: Logs that the NCM protocol setup is missing.

methods.name: proto_3g_setup
methods.description: Logs that the 3G protocol setup is missing.

methods.name: proto_directip_setup
methods.description: Logs that the direct IP protocol setup is missing.

methods.name: proto_wwan_init_config
methods.description: Initializes WWAN protocol configuration parameters, adding string configuration options such as APN, auth, username, password, etc.

methods.name: proto_wwan_setup
methods.description: Detects and configures WWAN USB devices, sets driver and device paths, and initializes appropriate protocol setup functions based on detected device and driver.

methods.name: proto_wwan_teardown
methods.description: Tears down the WWAN protocol based on stored driver and device information.
